prompt: Ho appena fixato un bug nel token tracking. L'input_tokens includeva i cached tokens causando la stamina bar a mostrare 100%. Salva questa scoperta nel brain.

assertions.name: has_yaml_frontmatter
assertions.description: Output file has valid YAML frontmatter with type, project, created, last_verified, tags fields

assertions.name: correct_type_field
assertions.description: Frontmatter type is bug_fix or bug

assertions.name: kebab_case_filename
assertions.description: Filename uses descriptive kebab-case (not generic like bug-fix-1.md)

assertions.name: has_structured_sections
assertions.description: Contains Problem, Solution, and Key Insight sections

assertions.name: correct_location
assertions.description: File is saved in documentation/bugs/ directory structure
